deadline.value: International applicants: January 15 for Fall (September) entry (Winter March 30, Summer September 1); committee review one month after the deadline.
deadline.quote: The Admissions committee for Biological Sciences reviews applications one month after deadline. | US applicants are encouraged to apply by the international deadline due to study permit application times. International applicants Term Annual application deadlines Fall (September) January 15 Winter (January) March 30 Summer (May) September 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for this field and the program page does not mention one.

supervisor.value: You must select a faculty supervisor before admission; supervisor support is part of the application.
supervisor.quote: applicants are required to select one of our faculty members to be their supervisor and preside over an applicant’s program before they are accepted for admission

funding.value: The department's awards page lists scholarships and travel awards but no guaranteed PhD stipend.

entry_route.value: An MSc is normally required, but MSc-to-PhD transfer and direct PhD entry without an MSc are possible in some circumstances.
entry_route.quote: you must have a minimum of a Master of Science (MSc) degree; however, under certain circumstances transfer from a MSc to PhD program and entry into the PhD without a MSc is possible

notes: Microbiology (PhD) is a separate Faculty of Science program.
